text: Sorry to trouble you at this hour. My granddaughter is 9 and I think her temperature was 39.9 earlier, if I read the thermometer right, I'm not great with the digital ones. She's had some ibuprofen and since then she seems alright, I'd say. She's playing her games, she's had a good drink of juice, chatting away to me. She's wide awake, watching her programme now, not dozy at all as far as I can tell. I'm probably fretting for no reason, but I wasn't sure if that number on its own was too high. Apologies again.
